## What changed

## Change type

- [ ] Application, tooling, or documentation
- [ ] Editorial publication or correction

## Local verification

- [ ] `bun test ./tests` passes
- [ ] `bun run build` passes
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e` passes for reader-facing changes
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, local environment files, or generated artifacts are included
- [ ] Deployment changes preserve other applications on the shared EC2 instance

## Editorial evidence (publication or correction only)

- [ ] Every factual claim has a matching primary-source quote
- [ ] Source URLs open the claimed document, not a homepage or repost
- [ ] Confidence and status labels match the evidence
- [ ] The strongest credible counterpoint is represented
- [ ] No hype language or unsupported prediction remains

## Editorial decision (publication or correction only)

- [ ] This edition is ready to publish

Application changes do not approve the pilot or authorize a production deployment.
